item.title: Solved: How to Merge PDF Files Using Python
item.description:
Is it feasible to combine separate PDF files with Python? Absolutely! In this deep dive, we’ll explore multiple strategies to merge PDFs effectively, handling scenarios like looping through directories, merging all files, and even excluding specific pages, such as those pesky blank pages left over from report generation. Let’s delve into several solutions that leverage different libraries available in the Python ecosystem.

Solution 1: Leveraging PyPDF2

A robust and easy-to-use library is PyPDF2 . This library, a fork of PyPDF, offers excellent functionality for merging PDFs.
